question:
A, B, C, D, P, Q, and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only three people sit between D and R when counted from the right of R.B is an immediate neighbour of both R and Q.P sits second to the left of D.C is not an immediate neighbour of D.

Who is sitting third to the right of R?
solution:
**Given**: A, B, C, D, P, Q, and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Based on the given conditions in the question, we get the following arrangements-

1. Only three people sit between D and R when counted from the right of R. P sits second to the left of D. From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582a230b4506e67a542c36db8d19e8ba0b88fd459e6568620bc9fca682d41058.png] 

2. B is an immediate neighbour of both R and Q. C is not an immediate neighbour of D. From these, we get the final arrangement as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa7c3cbdeefc1a46c8ce3a1b8a56c2a9cfbdb722d4547de40dcf8a4bfd8e650.png] 

Therefore, we see that A sits third to the right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.
